notes:
Matches start about half a minute sooner, and hosting is region-aware for real.

**The lobby no longer waits for people who aren't coming.** Every match held the lobby open for a fixed 45 seconds so players could join. Solo, that meant sitting in an empty lobby watching a timer for the whole 45 seconds — the largest single chunk of the two-minute wait, and none of it doing anything. The hold is now a ceiling rather than a target: every player who joins re-arms a short wait for anyone else, and the bus leaves once nobody else is arriving. A lobby that keeps filling still waits, up to the same 45 seconds as before.

**Players in one part of the world no longer get sent to a server in another.** The coordinator decides whether a region needs its own host, and it was answering that question without looking at regions — so one server anywhere in the world counted as "covered" everywhere. A second host was never started, and distant players were routed across the planet. The careful proximity-based host election that already existed never got a say, because the demand it reacts to had already been marked as handled. Routing a player who is already on their way is unchanged and still never fails.

Also in this release: the region maths and the host election now have a test suite of their own — 13 tests covering distance ordering, lobby scoring, and the rule that a nearby ordinary PC should host instead of a powerful one on another continent.
